label: Aruba Instant On AP15 (RW) 4x4 11ac Wave2 Indoor Access Point (R2X06A)
description: Aruba Instant On AP15 (R2X06A) - dual-radio 802.11ac Wave 2 indoor AP, 4x4:4 on both bands (300 Mbps 2.4 GHz + 1.7 Gbps 5 GHz). Single 1G RJ45 uplink with 802.3af PoE-in or 12 V DC, USB host port, BLE radio; supports Instant On gateway/router mode.
